svg.aria-label: Seven hundred handwritten digit images of 64 pixels each projected to two dimensions by PCA, where the ten classes overlap heavily, and by t-SNE, where they form ten mostly separate clusters
svg.text: scikit-learn digits dataset (8×8 images = 64 features), 700 random samples; colour and numeral = true class.
t-SNE axes mean nothing and between-cluster distances are not preserved: use it to look.
